method: Live multi-UA GETs (>=850ms, no parallel) + full 12-category walk via real GenericRetailAdapter.extractCatalogProducts + global URL dedup + sitemap diff + 3-outcome sort counter-control. DB siteProfile is the answer key.

Live count = 3437 product <loc> on page=1, page=2 returns HTTP 404 (empty). R1 blind candidate (3437) is CORRECT and current. DB value 3260 is stale (2026-04-06 snapshot; catalog grew ~177).

corrections.liveMethod: Code trace product-count-probe.ts:299-311 + type SitemapIndexMethod (l39-42) + live sitemap fetch

DB legacy keys {sitemapUrl,subSitemapPattern} produce m.urls===undefined; the case does `for (const x of m.urls)` -> TypeError -> caught at l540 -> returns null. validateMethod (l183-194) does NOT catch this (C1 loop is skipped when urls is undefined). codeFindings.detail: DB productCountMethod {method:'sitemap-index', sitemapUrl, subSitemapPattern} has NO urls[]. Switch does `for (const x of m.urls)` with m.urls===undefined -> TypeError -> caught by outer try at l540 -> returns null. validateMethod does NOT guard it (name 'sitemap-index' is valid; C1 url-shape loop is skipped because Array.isArray(undefined)===false). CONFIRMED silent-null at runtime. Fix for FOC: switch to scalar {method:'sitemap', url:'/xmlsitemap.php?type=products&page=1'} (case l291-297 reads m.url and returned 3437 live). Broader fleet fix: make sitemap-index tolerate legacy {sitemapUrl,subSitemapPattern} by expanding to urls[] (walk page=N until 404), OR have validateMethod throw on missing urls[] so it surfaces loudly instead of silent null.

The leading-slash bug only affects pattern.type==='path' (l122-126). FOC's paginationPattern.type is 'query', which hits the default branch (l153-157: url.searchParams.set('page',N)) -> produces /firearms?limit=250&sort=newest&page=2 correctly. So Theme-B's path-template bug DOES NOT apply to FOC. Live-confirmed this BC site HTML-paginates via ?page=N (page 2 returns different products than page 1; pagination anchors are query-style and carry sort+limit). No API pagination involved. No code change needed for FOC pagination.

Confirmed passive via 9 clean multi-UA GETs (all 200, cf-ray, __cf_bm, no challenge, no UA escalation). DB hasWaf:true is the invalid 'true + cloudflare-passive' combo flagged in Theme D; should be hasWaf:false. R1 blind candidate already corrected this to false.

coverageProof.walked: all 12 catalogUrls, sort=newest&limit=250, >=850ms between requests, global dedup by canonical product path via real GenericRetailAdapter.extractCatalogProducts

gap.characterization: 425 sitemap product URLs are NOT reachable via any of the 12 top-nav categories; 0 walked products are absent from the sitemap (walk is a strict subset). 4/4 sampled gap URLs returned HTTP 200 live products (ammo/optics/parts not assigned to top-nav category trees). No global 'shop-all' listing exists (/products,/all,/shop-all all 404). /brands is a 120-brand index; closing the gap would require walking all brand listings (heavy, high category overlap).
gap.verdict: Gap is real and acceptable per DB design: expectedProductCount (sitemap=3437) is the authoritative count; catalogUrls (87.7%) are the indexing spine for watermark/bootstrap. Closing the final 12.4% would require brand-listing walk (deferred / optional).

coverageProof.note: All 12 categories contribute unique products (greedy set-cover requires all 12). None redundant. /pre-owned/ kept (7 live items, Mistake 12). limit=250 baked in to minimize pages walked (firearms=4 pages, all others <=2).
